how_to_apply: Visit the official MP ESB website, www.esb.mp.gov.in, or the MP Online portal.

Register/login and fill the online application form for the "Group-3 Sub Engineer, Cartographer, Laboratory Technician and Other Equivalent Posts Combined Recruitment Exam 2026" between 18.08.2026 and 01.09.2026.
Indicate your post preference/priority carefully among the available post codes and technical streams, as post-priority changes are not accepted after the correction window closes.
Ensure a live Aadhaar registration, as Aadhaar registration is mandatory for candidates.
Pay the applicable exam fee online, plus the MP Online portal fee (₹60 via kiosk or ₹20 via registered citizen login).
Use the correction window (18.08.2026 to 06.09.2026) to fix any errors in the submitted application.
Download the admit card (T.A.C. – Time, Admission, Center slip) from the Board's website closer to the exam date.
important_instructions: Aadhaar registration is mandatory for all candidates; multi-level biometric verification is mandatory at the time of exam entry and during the exam, and Aadhaar must be unlocked at the time of biometric verification. Candidates must carry an original photo identity proof (Voter ID, PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Driving Licence, or Passport) to the exam centre; e-Aadhaar is valid only if verified through UIDAI. Candidates without a valid original photo ID will not be allowed to sit for the exam. Candidates will be allowed entry into the exam room only until the specified reporting time; late candidates will not be granted entry. Use of electronic devices such as mobile phones, calculators, log tables, digital watches, sunglasses, and any unfair-means material is strictly prohibited in the exam room. Candidates must safely retain their online application number, as the admit card can be obtained only through it. Candidates must bring a black ball-point pen and their downloaded admit card to the exam hall. No candidate will be permitted to leave the exam room between the start and end of the exam. Any technical error causing delay in the start of the exam will not disadvantage candidates - full time will still be provided to attempt the paper. The Board's role is limited to conducting the exam and providing results to the concerned departments; the entire responsibility for the appointment process rests with the respective department. Candidates from Madhya Pradesh's special primitive tribal communities (Baiga, Sahariya/Saharia, and Bharia) applying for non-executive posts under the Scheduled Tribe category must send their applications with all required documents directly to the concerned department in hard copy (Format-2 of the rule book) rather than to the ESB, by the application closing date; applications sent to ESB in such cases will not be considered valid. Where the department's post is executive in nature, no exam exemption applies to these communities and they must apply online as Scheduled Tribe candidates.

faq.question: Q1. What is MP ESB Group-3 Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a combined recruitment exam conducted by the Madhya Pradesh Karmchari Chayan Mandal (MP ESB) to fill Group-3 (Class III) Sub Engineer, Cartographer, Laboratory Technician and other equivalent technical posts across multiple Madhya Pradesh government departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MP ESB Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MPESB Group 3 Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026 has 1,040 vacancies for Sub Engineer, Draftsman, Technical Assistant and other posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MP ESB Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 01.09.2026. A correction window remains open until 06.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for MP ESB Sub Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements are set by each demanding department under its own departmental recruitment rules and vary by post code and technical stream (Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, Computer Science, Electronics & Telecommunication, and others). Candidates should check the specific post code's requirement in the official rule book.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MP ESB Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 40 years old (general category), calculated as on 01.01.2026. MP-domicile SC/ST/OBC candidates, government employees, and women candidates get relaxation up to 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MP ESB Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The exam fee is ₹500 per paper for unreserved candidates and ₹250 per paper for MP-domicile SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Divyangjan candidates, plus an MP Online portal fee of ₹60 (kiosk) or ₹20 (registered login). No fee applies to backlog direct recruitment posts.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for MP ESB Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online at www.esb.mp.gov.in or through the MP Online portal between 18.08.2026 and 01.09.2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MP ESB Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a single computer-based online exam of 200 marks (100 marks General Studies + 100 marks Technical/branch-specific), subject to minimum qualifying marks and department-wise vacancy demand and appointment criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What is the exam date for MP ESB Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The exam is scheduled to begin from 06.10.2026 (Tuesday), conducted in two shifts per day.

faq.question: Q10. What is the exam pattern for MP ESB Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The exam has a single paper of 200 marks: Part A covers General Knowledge, Hindi, English, Mathematics, Reasoning, Science, and Computer Knowledge (100 marks); Part B covers technical/branch-specific subject questions (100 marks), based on the candidate's applied stream.
